not_for: retroactive reinterpretation of Track C or D0
provenance: The classical source (P.R. Sarkar acoustic-root varna/vrtti table) supplies single acoustic-root meanings per consonant. The four sphere fields (physical/mental/intellectual/spiritual) are a RESEARCHER interpretive expansion of those roots, not present in the source. This is a candidate representation for testing, NOT validated content.
key_convention: Keys match frozen/assignment.json (34 consonant varnas). Transliteration variants are recorded in per-entry 'aliases' rather than introducing conflicting keys.
must_freeze_before_run: This file must be hash-pinned and frozen (authored blind to the target word list, with inter-annotator agreement recorded) BEFORE any real Track E run. As shipped it is an unfrozen candidate draft.
packetization_warning: Root names and varna names must not be sent to scorers in blinded scoring packets when they can leak target meaning; every entry sets packetize_root=false and records a leak_risk. The pre-send leak scan must also strip surface words and root-names such as moha/bhaya/kama/trishna/lobha.

leak_risk_legend.high: root directly names a likely target candidate (e.g. moha, bhaya, kama, trishna, greed, fear, desire, attachment) — must never be packetized
leak_risk_legend.medium: root is an abstract principle that could still hint at a candidate
leak_risk_legend.low: root unlikely to name a target candidate

ka.root: asha / hope; creation; karya brahma; flowing water-sound
ka.physical: flow, survival movement, water, visible creation and manifestation
ka.intellectual: projection of future possibility; constructive imagination
ka.spiritual: expressed universe, creation-field, emergence into manifestation
ka.source_notes: Classical root: aasha (hope) / creation / Karya Brahma. Flat binding gloss: 'hope / forward-grasping desire'.

kha.root: cinta / worry; crude heaven; impersonal thought
kha.physical: open but unstable space; external uncertainty
kha.spiritual: crude heavenly plane; lower expansive field, not yet transcendental
kha.source_notes: Classical root: cinta (worry). Flat binding gloss: 'worry / impersonal thought'.

ga.root: ceshta / effort to arouse dormant potential
ga.physical: action, effort, mobilization, activation of dormant power
ga.spiritual: effort as path to mundane development and spiritual elevation
ga.source_notes: Classical root: ceshta (effort). Flat binding gloss: 'effort / striving'.

gha.intellectual: biased judgment through attachment to time/place/person
gha.spiritual: bondage through limited love; can expand into universal love if sublimated
gha.source_notes: Classical root: mamata (attachment). Flat binding gloss: 'attachment / mine-ness'.

nga.spiritual: egoic obstruction; humility is its spiritual correction
nga.source_notes: Classical root: dambha (vanity). Flat binding gloss: 'vanity / pride-display'. Key 'nga' per assignment.json.

ca.physical: restraint in action; ethical pause before doing
ca.source_notes: Classical root: viveka (conscience/discrimination). Flat binding gloss: 'lack of discrimination / confused discernment' (binding/opposite sense).

cha.physical: breakdown of function, collapse of coordination
cha.spiritual: loss of inner steadiness; needs re-integration
cha.source_notes: Classical root: vikalata (nervous breakdown). Flat binding gloss: 'nervous breakdown / collapse'.

ja.source_notes: Classical root: ahamkara (ego). Flat binding gloss: 'ego / inflated I-feeling'.

jha.source_notes: Classical root: lolupata / lobha (greed). Flat binding gloss: 'greed / avarice'.

nya.spiritual: spiritual falseness; split between outer virtue and inner conduct
nya.source_notes: Classical root: kapatata (hypocrisy). Flat binding gloss: 'hypocrisy / deceit'. Key 'nya' per assignment.json.

tta.spiritual: misuse of speech; needs silence / balanced speech
tta.source_notes: Classical root: vitarka (overstatement). Flat binding gloss: 'overstatement / garrulousness'. Retroflex ta.

ttha.physical: heat after action; bodily remorse response
ttha.intellectual: recognition of impropriety after the fact
ttha.spiritual: repentance as possible doorway to correction
ttha.source_notes: Classical root: anutapa (repentance). Flat binding gloss: 'repentance / remorse'. Retroflex tha.

dda.spiritual: humility if purified; blockage if fear-based
dda.source_notes: Classical root: lajja (shyness). Flat binding gloss: 'shyness'. Retroflex da.

ddha.spiritual: severe fall into cruelty; compassion is its correction
ddha.source_notes: Classical root: pishunata (sadistic cruelty). Flat binding gloss: 'sadistic cruelty'. Retroflex dha.

nna.spiritual: bondage through comparison; sympathetic joy (mudita) is its correction
nna.source_notes: Classical root: irshya (envy). Flat binding gloss: 'envy'. Retroflex na.

ta.root: staticity, deep sleep, dullness, spiritual inertness
ta.spiritual: spiritual inertness that discipline seeks to liberate from
ta.source_notes: Classical root: staticity / long sleep / dullness. Flat binding gloss: 'inertia / staticity / dullness'.

tha.source_notes: Classical root: vishada (melancholy). Flat binding gloss: 'melancholy / dejection'.

da.spiritual: small egoic contraction; patience softens it
da.source_notes: Classical root: peevishness. Flat binding gloss: 'peevishness / irritability'.

dha.physical: acquisition, hoarding, pursuit of wealth / name / power
dha.spiritual: bondage through endless acquisition; spiritual ideation redirects it
dha.source_notes: Classical root: trishna (thirst/craving). Flat binding gloss: 'craving / thirst for acquisition'.

na.physical: clinging to person / place / object / time
na.spiritual: bondage through infatuation; indifference and spiritual ideation free it
na.source_notes: Classical root: moha (delusion/infatuation). Flat binding gloss: 'blind attachment / infatuation'.

pa.spiritual: fetter of hatred; related to moha and fear
pa.source_notes: Classical root: ghrina (hatred/revulsion). Flat binding gloss: 'hatred / revulsion'.

pha.spiritual: bondage through fear; fearlessness is correction
pha.source_notes: Classical root: bhaya (fear). Flat binding gloss: 'fear'.

ba.spiritual: spiritual dullness through neglect; respect/attention is correction
ba.source_notes: Classical root: avajna (indifference). Flat binding gloss: 'indifference / neglect'.

bha.root: murccha / loss of common sense under ripu
bha.intellectual: judgment overwhelmed by desire / anger / etc.
bha.spiritual: loss of self-command; pratyahara (withdrawal) restores control
bha.source_notes: Classical root: murccha (fainting of judgement). Flat binding gloss: 'deluded obsession'.

ma.spiritual: annihilation if unrestrained; discipline / sublimation needed
ma.source_notes: Classical root: pranasha (annihilation) / prashraya (indulgence). Flat binding gloss: 'annihilation / indulgence (giving latitude)'.

ya.root: avishvasa / lack of confidence; constant air-like movement
ya.spiritual: unstable faith; needs trust and inner steadiness
ya.source_notes: Classical root: avishvasa (lack of confidence). Flat binding gloss: 'lack of confidence / wavering movement'.

ra.root: agni-tattva, prana-shakti, vitality, fire; sarvanasha / annihilation-thought
ra.intellectual: decisive force; destructive or illuminating cognition
ra.spiritual: fire of life-force; can become defeatism or spiritual energy
ra.source_notes: Classical root: agni/prana (fire, vitality) and sarvanasha (annihilation-thought). Flat binding gloss: "defeatist annihilation-thought ('everything is gone, I am undone')".

la.source_notes: Classical root: krurata (cruelty) / kshiti (solid factor). Flat binding gloss: 'cruelty'.

va.mental: natural movement toward happiness and rightness
va.spiritual: dharma; movement toward subtlety; ensconcement in original stance
va.source_notes: Classical root: dharma / jala (liquid factor) / Varuna. Flat binding gloss: 'holding / ensconcement in original stance (BINDS)'.

sha.spiritual: rajas; artha as psychic longing and worldly movement
sha.source_notes: Classical root: rajo-guna / artha (psychic longing). Flat binding gloss: 'mutative drive / material pursuit'.

ssa.physical: physical longing, material desire, sensual pursuit
ssa.mental: desire, attraction, craving for status / pleasure
ssa.source_notes: Classical root: tamo-guna / kama (physical desire). Flat binding gloss: 'static inertia / worldly desire'. Key 'ssa' per assignment.json; source distinguishes sha/sa/ssa.

sa.source_notes: Classical root: moksha / sattva-guna. Flat binding gloss: 'escapism / premature static withdrawal' (binding/opposite sense).

ha.root: ether, daytime, sun, svarloka, paravidya; hao = Shiva dancing tandava
ha.physical: ether, open sky, day, solar radiance
ha.mental: clarity, wakefulness, expansion out of darkness
ha.spiritual: svarloka, solar ascent, Shivaic dynamism, tandava force
ha.source_notes: Classical root: ether / day / sun / svarloka / paravidya. Flat binding gloss: 'night / darkness (the contractive opposite of ha = day/sun/light)'.

ksha.root: mundane / material knowledge; transcendent heaven beyond crude kha
ksha.physical: structured material field, science of objects
ksha.spiritual: higher-than-crude heavenly knowledge, yet still mundane / material (not paravidya)
ksha.source_notes: Classical root: mundane / material knowledge (kshatra of heaven). Flat binding gloss: 'mundane / material knowledge'.
